A course evaluation in which students rate each part of a course on one grid, compared across students who attended in person and online. surveyframe declares the analysis in advance (Descriptive statistics, Frequencies and percentages, Cross-tabulation) and reports it in APA 7.

## In SurveyStudio

In RStudio, open the Addins menu, choose **surveyframe: Try a demo** and pick `matrix_likert`. The study opens on the Design screen. Plan shows each research question with its method and decision rule, Analyse runs them as declared, and Report writes the APA 7 report.

![The Design screen with the matrix_likert study.](../../templates/matrix_likert/design.png){width=100%}

## In R

```r
d <- sframe_demo("matrix_likert")
results <- run_analysis_plan(d$responses, d$instrument)
render_report(d$instrument, d$responses)
```

## What the report gives

| Research question | Method | What the report gives |
|---|---|---|
| How was each part of the course rated? | Descriptive statistics | The APA 7 sentence, its table and chart |
| How were ratings of the lectures distributed? | Frequencies and percentages | The APA 7 sentence, its table and chart |
| Did in-person and online students rate the lectures differently? | Cross-tabulation | The APA 7 sentence, its table and chart |

The demo's data is simulated, so the site shows no numbers. Run it in SurveyStudio or R to see the results, each marked as demonstration data.
